title: LCARS Shell Dashboard Strategy
description: Dashboard strategy that generates a full LCARS shell (header, sidebars, content panel) on a custom:lcards-layout-view. Set it as the dashboard's `strategy:` block.

room_selector_entity.title: Room selector
room_selector_entity.description: The room the light panel shows. An input_select or select lists its own options as the rooms (name each option after an area). An input_text lists every area in Home Assistant and stores the one picked. Leave it empty to show a placeholder.

page_selector_entity.title: Page selector
page_selector_entity.description: An input_select or select whose options become the page menu in the left sidebar. Picking a page sets the entity; use its state in Visibility conditions after you take control.

top_bar_entity.title: Top bar toggle
top_bar_entity.description: An input_boolean that shows or hides the top bar. The first button under the top left corner toggles it.

right_sidebar_entity.title: Right sidebar toggle
right_sidebar_entity.description: An input_boolean that shows or hides the right sidebar. The second button under the top left corner toggles it.
